mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, the skies are clear and it is 40 degrees near the Verona Area High School. We are currently in the first quarter moon phase. The overnight low will be 35 degrees with no rain expected. If you are an early riser, the ISS will be visible for four minutes starting at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and moving high in the sky toward Fitchburg and Madison.

In local news, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on Thursday, October 15, for operating a vehicle while impaired while students were on board. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a sign. Additionally, residents are reminded that the city has updated its zoning and polling location information, which can be viewed through the interactive maps on the city website.

There is plenty to do in our community this weekend. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market takes place at the Capitol Square, and you can catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join Trivia Night at the Hop Haus on Monday or The Bogey Factory next Wednesday.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior. The driver was transported for an evidentiary chemical test, and officials confirmed that alcohol was not a factor.
Today's flavor was the popular Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. Since the restaurant is now closed for the night, please note that we will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM featuring the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
